data.body: Investigation trail: (1) 'rebar bridge check-access' vs live REB passed CREATE/LABEL/PROPERTY_WRITE/PROPERTY_READ/DELETE (self-cleaning finally-delete); only STEP_JQL_SEARCH failed with no_results_after_retry due to Cloud Lucene-index eventual-consistency lag exceeding the fixed 6x5s budget. (2) The DC harness (tests/external/live_jira_dc) drives the coordinator via bridge subprocess with --filter-local-ids over a scrubbed-copy store; but --filter-local-ids is legacy-route-only (request.py:95) and this epic removes that path, and a scrubbed-copy still enumerates ~2700 tickets — unsafe against shared-prod REB. Hence the direct coordinate_and_fuse([one_plan]) design: structural single-ticket bounding, no enumeration, no legacy flag. (3) Coordinator seams mapped: coordinate_and_fuse batch_dispatch.py:314; coordinate_create/_resolve_ambiguous create_coordinator.py:214; PassFuse pass_fuse.py; BindingLifecycle.bind_confirm. Design accepted by plan-review; final blocker was only the 8000-char description limit (narration moved here).
